messages:
alex_lead: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — thanks for the great Q&A. I want to capture the outstanding asks about the GTM playbook and partner pipeline here so we can action them.

maria_sales: Thanks Alex. Biggest ask from the field: can we get clearer guidance on priority ICPs for Q2 — who should SDRs prioritize when qualifying demos?

shawn_gtm: +1 from GTM. Also: timeline on partner enablement content (sales play decks, pricing cheat sheet). We need dates to coordinate co-sell motions.

jo_product: From product: there’s a roadmap item to surface model latency/cost per-route in console (requested by enterprise teams). Sales asked when it’ll be in beta so they can show it to procurement. Target?

alex_lead: Good calls. Quick answers: ICP — prioritize AI-native startups (Series A/B with >$10M ARR), mid-market SaaS with embed use cases, then regulated enterprise with clear compliance needs. We’ll share a one-pager for SDRs by EOD Friday.

alex_lead: Partner enablement: we committed to a partner kit in the Q2 launch plan. Draft kit (sales deck + pricing cadence + onboarding checklist) will be ready week of May 6. Finalized kit by May 20.

alex_lead: Console feature (latency/cost per route) — dev timeline currently targets internal beta May 15, external beta June 1. That’s subject to a small shift if kernel selection work slips.

lena_ops: For Dedicated/reserved capacity deals, finance needs a short checklist of what to collect during discovery (expected throughput, SLOs, data residency). Can we add that to the kit?

tina_cs: Yes please. CS will also need a handoff template for onboarding Dedicated customers (who owns infra vs CS vs solutions eng).

maria_sales: One more field question — pricing flexibility for pilot customers (3-6mo pilots). Can leadership clarify guardrails so AE’s know when to escalate?

alex_lead: Pricing guardrails: standard approach is no discount >15% without Revenue approval. For pilots under $50k ARR-equivalent, AMs can offer usage credits up to $10k without approval. Anything beyond that routes to revenue ops. We’ll document and circulate a short flowchart.

shawn_gtm: Is there a plan for partner referral vs. reseller incentives? Some ISV partners asked about margin and lead credits.

alex_lead: Yes — referral program (lead credits, co-marketing) rolls out first; reseller program (white-label/resell) is piloted with two partners in June. Margin details for reseller pilots will be shared with pilot partners; general reseller pricing sheet TBD.

jo_product: Quick technical ask from GTM: any guidance on recommended model variants for demo accounts (cheaper quantized variants vs full quality)? Sales want a recommended config for staging demos.

alex_lead: Recommend using our quantized mid-tier model for demos (good perf/cost balance). We’ll publish a short play: recommended model, prompt templates, and demo infra (how to bind to a demo key) by May 8.

maria_sales: Thanks — can we also get a one-slide ROI template for AEs to use in exec-sponsored pilots? Even simple monthly cost vs expected engagement numbers is helpful.

tina_cs: CS can draft the ROI slide if product provides the cost-per-token and throughput assumptions.

lena_ops: I’ll add the discovery checklist and handoff template to the partner kit doc. tagging @alex_lead for final sign-off when ready.

deploybot: deploybot: new doc created: /playbooks/partner-kit/drafts/partner_kit_v0.1.md by lena_ops

alex_lead: Great — action items: 1) SDR one-pager (Alex) by Fri EOD; 2) partner kit draft (Lena) week of May 6; 3) console beta dates (Jo/Product) internal beta May 15; 4) pricing guardrail flowchart (Revenue) by next Tue; 5) demo config/play (Jo) by May 8. If you’re owning any of those and need help, ping me here.

maria_sales: I’ll circulate a short list of top 12 field accounts that want to pilot — can teammates comment if you have high-priority prospects?

shawn_gtm: I’ll add partner prospect list to the draft kit.

tina_cs: I’ll draft the onboarding handoff template and post it here for review.

jo_product: Noted — will update console beta timeline in the public roadmap doc.

alex_lead: Thanks everyone. If any leadership follow-ups required, we’ll do a quick sync next Wednesday during office hours. Otherwise, we’ll track progress in the partner kit thread. :thumbsup:
